details: Spot Bitcoin ETFs experienced substantial outflows, with $649 million leaving the funds, marking the largest single-day outflow since January. This contributed to Bitcoin's price nearing the critical $76,000 support level, intensifying retail panic as market sentiment weakens.
title: Bitcoin Sees Significant ETF Outflows Amid Price Drop

details: Solana's real-world asset market capitalization increased by 43% quarter-over-quarter to $2.01 billion in Q1, driven by growing institutional interest. BlackRock's tokenized money market fund and collaborations with payment firms like Visa contributed to this growth.
title: Solana's Real-World Asset (RWA) Market Cap Surges

details: The U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) is reportedly preparing to release an "innovation exemption" for tokenized stocks as early as this week. This framework could allow equities to trade through crypto-native infrastructure, potentially transforming the U.S. equities market by enabling 24/7 trading and faster settlement.
title: SEC Expected to Introduce Tokenized Stocks Exemption This Week

details: Echo Protocol experienced an exploit on the Monad blockchain, resulting in the unauthorized minting of approximately 1,000 eBTC, valued at about $76.7 million. The attack was attributed to a compromised admin key. Echo Protocol has paused cross-chain functionality and is investigating the incident.
title: Echo Protocol Suffers $76.7 Million Exploit

details: Minnesota Governor Tim Walz signed a bill allowing state-chartered banks and credit unions to offer cryptocurrency custody services. This law, effective August 1, 2026, aims to provide a safer way for Minnesotans to manage crypto by strengthening protections against fraud and loss through regulatory oversight.
title: Minnesota Enacts Law for Crypto Custody by Banks

details: Strategy, a prominent corporate Bitcoin holder, announced the acquisition of 24,869 BTC for approximately $2.01 billion, bringing its total holdings to 843,738 BTC. This significant purchase was financed through stock offerings and increases the company's Bitcoin yield for 2026.
title: Strategy Acquires Additional $2 Billion in Bitcoin

details: The XRP Alliance has debuted, integrating Flare and D'CENT hardware wallets to provide XRP holders with non-custodial access to XRP yield vaults. This initiative, which also includes Doppler, Banxa, and Squid, aims to enhance XRP Finance (XRPFi) accessibility and development.
title: XRP Alliance Launches for Yield Opportunities
